claim.statement: Current OpenCode permission documentation defines allow, ask and deny actions; supports ordered, pattern-specific rules and per-agent overrides; and says most permissions default to allow while selected operations such as external-directory access and doom-loop handling default to ask.

source.title: OpenCode Permissions
source.locator: Actions; configuration; patterns; agent overrides; defaults; external directories

limitations: Permission documentation describes configuration semantics, not observed enforcement, bypass resistance or the effective rules of a session.
unknowns: The effective global, tool-specific, pattern-specific and per-agent rules, rule order, working directory and external-directory grants are unknown.
